rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement, and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay tenants relocation payments. The amount depends on the date the eviction notice is served. For notices served 3/01/26 to 2/28/27 the payment is $8,245 per tenant, capped at $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; +$5,497 per elderly (60+)/disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren) (notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenancies in San Francisco subject to the Rent Ordinance where the landlord terminates the tenancy for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.exemptions: Relocation for temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days is governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance § 37.9C.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to evictions on the listed no-fault grounds. The amount depends on the eviction notice service date and on whether tenants are elderly or disabled or the household has minor children.

rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.conflict_note: The archive table begins with notices served 8/10/06. The document does not state the ordinance's effective date. The current rate period runs 3/01/26–2/28/27.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting tenants under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from the rental market) must pay relocation payments. For notices served 3/01/26 to 2/28/27 the payment is $11,110.05 per tenant, capped at $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly (62+)/disabled tenant (notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants in San Francisco evicted under the Ellis Act.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to Ellis Act withdrawals. The amount depends on the eviction notice service date and on whether tenants are elderly (62+) or disabled.

rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

rules.title: Temporary relocation payments for capital improvement displacement under 20 days (San Francisco)
rules.requirement: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 rather than the SF Rent Ordinance.
rules.coverage_conditions: Temporary capital improvement evictions in San Francisco lasting less than 20 days.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Displacement must be temporary, for capital improvement work, and less than 20 days.

rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
